note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000, under the military government that took power on 12 October 1999. The National Assembly, Senate and provincial assemblies were suspended and no national election was scheduled, so political freedom is rated no_elections (the 2002 general election restored an elected parliament). Islam is the state religion and the Federal Shariat Court and Hudood Ordinances apply parts of Islamic law, so religion_state is religious_law_partial. The armed forces are volunteer.
